agents.name: Claude Code
agents.quote: In March 2026, I tried to use agentic IDEs like Antigravity and VS Code's Claude Code plugin.

also.quote: Every time I notice something I don't like, I add it to my ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md/~/.claude/CLAUDE.md so the agent can emulate my style.

agents.name: Antigravity
agents.quote: In March 2026, I tried to use agentic IDEs like Antigravity and VS Code's Claude Code plugin.

also.quote: Alternatively, gemini.md/claude.md can be symlinked toward an agent.md to have it active anywhere.

review_style.value: Reads all the code; LLM criticizes first
review_style.quote: While this "trick" has considerably improved the code generated, this is not a magic bullet that lets me avoid reading the code.

also.quote: As a result, I reduce my velocity by iterating over my PR until it reaches the same level of quality I would have produced "by hand".
Before sending a PR for review, the first thing I do is ask for the LLM to criticize/look for mistakes.

harness.value: Agentic IDE, a fresh session per feature
harness.quote: Keep the context short. This means starting a new session per feature.

rules_files.quote: Avoid superlatives and praise. Stop telling me I am absolutely right. Give me the cold hard truth.

history.quote: Every time I notice something I don't like, I add it to my ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md/~/.claude/CLAUDE.md so the agent can emulate my style.

signature.caption: when code quality drops
signature.why: Our pick: a one-line fix for context dilution, sent the moment the agent's style slips.
signature.quote: Explicitly ask the harness to reload agent.md. "Reload agent.md" is enough when I see code quality dropping.

archetype.why: Turns every review comment he repeats into a rule in his published agent.md.

signature_quote.value: LLMs constantly hallucinate and cannot be trusted.
signature_quote.more: I still have to verify and iterate a lot but now I usually focus on architecture and design instead of code style.
